newsitem.title: USA: Western Transmedia completes franchise sale.
newsitem.headline: Western Transmedia completes franchise sale.

text.p: Western Transmedia Co Inc on Friday said it has completed the sale of substantially all operating assets of its Transmedia Network franchise to Transmedia Network Inc.
In a statement, Western Transmedia said effective today it will change its name to The Western Systems Corp. Its Nasdaq symbol will remain the same.

The company's net assets will total about $8.8 million in cash and cash equivalents after payment of taxes and expenses of the sale transaction. He said the company intends to seek suitable investments or business combinations.
